Our Country Takes in Unwanted Villainesses. Banishing All These Excellent Noble Girls Is an Act of Foolishness That Will Ruin Their Countries, You Know?
synopsis: I was reincarnated as the Princess of a small, insignificant country only referred to as the Struntz Kindom. I, Brünhilde Rosenmüler Stuckenschmidt (yes I am aware my name is quite the mouthful), am the future Queen of my country. My Nation is surrounded by four other countries. Even though it's a small country, it's quite okay. All of those foolish surrounding nations have the tendency to banish their people who happen to have extraordinary talents with abilities so amazing that they are almost cheat-level skills. Thus begins the story of a reincarnated princess who aims to gather all of those banished "villainesses" and other villainous ladies into her Kingdom so that her small nation becomes the most powerfull and prosperous one of all!
